# Erdos.p913 — Erdős problem 913

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/913
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/913.lean`, theorem `erdos_913.variants.infinite_many_8p_sq_add_one_primes`, AMS 11).

It is likely that there are infinitely many primes $p$ such that $8p^2 - 1$ is also prime.

## Statement
{ p | p.Prime ∧ (8 * p ^ 2 - 1).Prime }.Infinite

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
